mapper.sql: EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM SMT_ISC_DOWN_RECORD ACTIVE_RECORD WHERE ACTIVE_RECORD.ID != DR.ID AND ACTIVE_RECORD.DEVICE_TYPE = 1 AND ACTIVE_RECORD.SERVICE_TYPE IN (3, 6) AND ACTIVE_RECORD.DEVICE_CODE = DR.DEVICE_CODE AND NVL(ACTIVE_RECORD.PARK_ID, -1) = NVL(DR.PARK_ID, -1) AND ACTIVE_RECORD.OVER_TIME > #{now} AND ( (DR.PERSON_ID IS NOT NULL AND ACTIVE_RECORD.PERSON_ID = DR.PERSON_ID) OR (DR.BADGE IS NOT NULL AND ACTIVE_RECORD.BADGE = DR.BADGE) OR (DR.PERSON_ID IS NULL AND DR.BADGE IS NULL AND ACTIVE_RECORD.CARD_NO = DR.CARD_NO) ) )

sql.if: AND ( DR.GENERAL LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}), '%') OR DR.BADGE LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}), '%') OR DR.CARD_NO LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}), '%') OR DR.PERSON_ID LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}), '%') )

AND ( NVL(STAFF.NAME, DR.GENERAL) LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}), '%') OR STAFF.BADGE LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}), '%') OR DR.CARD_NO LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}), '%') OR DR.PERSON_ID LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}), '%') )

if.test: query.personType != null and query.personType != '' and query.personType != 'VISITOR'
query.personType != null and query.personType != '' and query.personType != 'STAFF'

mapper.sql: SELECT DR.ID AS DOWN_RECORD_ID, DR.PARK_ID AS PARK_ID, PARK.PARK_NAME AS PARK_NAME, DR.DEVICE_CODE AS DEVICE_CODE, DEVICE.DEVICE_NAME AS DEVICE_NAME, DR.CARD_NO AS CARD_NO, DR.BADGE AS BADGE, DR.PERSON_ID AS PERSON_ID, DR.GENERAL AS PERSON_NAME, DR.SERVICE_TYPE AS SERVICE_TYPE, CASE WHEN DR.SERVICE_TYPE = 3 THEN '访客预约' WHEN DR.SERVICE_TYPE = 6 THEN '入厂申请' ELSE '临时权限' END AS SERVICE_TYPE_DESC, DR.START_TIME AS START_TIME, DR.OVER_TIME AS OVER_TIME, 'VISITOR' AS PERSON_TYPE, '访客' AS PERSON_TYPE_DESC, AS HAS_ACTIVE_SAME_PERSON FROM SMT_ISC_DOWN_RECORD DR LEFT JOIN SMT_DEVICE DEVICE ON DEVICE.ID = DR.DEVICE_CODE LEFT JOIN SMT_PARK PARK ON PARK.ID = DR.PARK_ID WHERE DR.DEVICE_TYPE = 1 AND DR.SERVICE_TYPE IN (3, 6) AND DR.OVER_TIME < #{now}

SELECT DR.ID AS DOWN_RECORD_ID, DR.PARK_ID AS PARK_ID, PARK.PARK_NAME AS PARK_NAME, DR.DEVICE_CODE AS DEVICE_CODE, DEVICE.DEVICE_NAME AS DEVICE_NAME, DR.CARD_NO AS CARD_NO, STAFF.BADGE AS BADGE, DR.PERSON_ID AS PERSON_ID, NVL(STAFF.NAME, DR.GENERAL) AS PERSON_NAME, DR.SERVICE_TYPE AS SERVICE_TYPE, CASE WHEN DR.SERVICE_TYPE = 7 THEN '人脸更新' ELSE '员工权限' END AS SERVICE_TYPE_DESC, DR.START_TIME AS START_TIME, DR.OVER_TIME AS OVER_TIME, 'STAFF' AS PERSON_TYPE, '离职人员' AS PERSON_TYPE_DESC, 0 AS HAS_ACTIVE_SAME_PERSON FROM SMT_ISC_DOWN_RECORD DR JOIN SMT_STAFF STAFF ON STAFF.ID = CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(DR.CARD_NO, '^[0-9]+$') THEN TO_NUMBER(DR.CARD_NO) END LEFT JOIN SMT_DEVICE DEVICE ON DEVICE.ID = DR.DEVICE_CODE LEFT JOIN SMT_PARK PARK ON PARK.ID = DR.PARK_ID WHERE DR.DEVICE_TYPE = 1 AND DR.SERVICE_TYPE IN (1, 7) AND STAFF.STATUS = 0

SELECT DR.PARK_ID AS PARK_ID, DR.DEVICE_CODE AS DEVICE_CODE, DR.CARD_NO AS CARD_NO, DR.BADGE AS BADGE, DR.PERSON_ID AS PERSON_ID, DR.SERVICE_TYPE AS SERVICE_TYPE, 'VISITOR' AS PERSON_TYPE, AS HAS_ACTIVE_SAME_PERSON FROM SMT_ISC_DOWN_RECORD DR WHERE DR.DEVICE_TYPE = 1 AND DR.SERVICE_TYPE IN (3, 6) AND DR.OVER_TIME < #{now}

SELECT DR.PARK_ID AS PARK_ID, DR.DEVICE_CODE AS DEVICE_CODE, DR.CARD_NO AS CARD_NO, STAFF.BADGE AS BADGE, DR.PERSON_ID AS PERSON_ID, DR.SERVICE_TYPE AS SERVICE_TYPE, 'STAFF' AS PERSON_TYPE, 0 AS HAS_ACTIVE_SAME_PERSON FROM SMT_ISC_DOWN_RECORD DR JOIN SMT_STAFF STAFF ON STAFF.ID = CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(DR.CARD_NO, '^[0-9]+$') THEN TO_NUMBER(DR.CARD_NO) END WHERE DR.DEVICE_TYPE = 1 AND DR.SERVICE_TYPE IN (1, 7) AND STAFF.STATUS = 0

EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM SMT_ISC_DEVICE_TASK DT WHERE DT.ACTION = 2 AND DT.DEVICE_TYPE = 1 AND DT.DEVICE_CODE = CLEANUP.DEVICE_CODE AND (DT.STATUS IS NULL OR DT.STATUS IN (0, 2, 3, 6)) AND ( ( CLEANUP.PERSON_TYPE = 'STAFF' AND DT.CARD_NO = CLEANUP.CARD_NO AND DT.SERVICE_TYPE IN (1, 7) ) OR ( CLEANUP.PERSON_TYPE = 'VISITOR' AND DT.SERVICE_TYPE = CLEANUP.SERVICE_TYPE AND ( (CLEANUP.PERSON_ID IS NOT NULL AND DT.PERSON_ID = CLEANUP.PERSON_ID) OR (CLEANUP.PERSON_ID IS NULL AND CLEANUP.BADGE IS NOT NULL AND DT.BADGE = CLEANUP.BADGE) OR (CLEANUP.PERSON_ID IS NULL AND CLEANUP.BADGE IS NULL AND DT.CARD_NO = CLEANUP.CARD_NO) ) ) ) )

EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM SMT_ISC_DEVICE_TASK DT WHERE DT.ACTION = 2 AND DT.DEVICE_TYPE = 1 AND DT.DEVICE_CODE = CLEANUP.DEVICE_CODE AND DT.STATUS IN (2, 6) AND ( ( CLEANUP.PERSON_TYPE = 'STAFF' AND DT.CARD_NO = CLEANUP.CARD_NO AND DT.SERVICE_TYPE IN (1, 7) ) OR ( CLEANUP.PERSON_TYPE = 'VISITOR' AND DT.SERVICE_TYPE = CLEANUP.SERVICE_TYPE AND ( (CLEANUP.PERSON_ID IS NOT NULL AND DT.PERSON_ID = CLEANUP.PERSON_ID) OR (CLEANUP.PERSON_ID IS NULL AND CLEANUP.BADGE IS NOT NULL AND DT.BADGE = CLEANUP.BADGE) OR (CLEANUP.PERSON_ID IS NULL AND CLEANUP.BADGE IS NULL AND DT.CARD_NO = CLEANUP.CARD_NO) ) ) ) )
